ng-add.description: Adds @koobiq/components library to the project and installs dependencies

new-icons-pack.description: Updates prefixes and names of changed/removed icons

css-selectors.description: Updates prefixes and names of changed/removed icons

deprecated-icons.description: Updates prefixes and names of changed/removed icons

empty-state-size-attr.description: Updates attr name and value in ts and html

loader-overlay-size-attr.description: Updates attr name and value in ts and html

autocomplete-panel-width-auto.description: Replaces kbq-autocomplete panelWidth="auto" with panelWidth="fit-content" in ts and html

icons-replacement.description: Updates names of icons in dedicated files

v20-upgrade.description: Migrates deprecated API removed in @koobiq/components v20.0.0

filter-bar-signals.description: Migrates KbqFilterBar consumers to the signal-based API (filter/pipeTemplates/isChanged/... reads become calls)

alert-signals.description: Migrates KbqAlert consumers to the signal-based API (compact/alertStyle reads become calls; warns on alertColor value change, now-protected members, narrowed inputs)

dropdown-demote-overlay.description: Removes the demoteOverlay input, the KBQ_DROPDOWN_HOST provider and dead .cdk-overlay-container_dropdown styles left by the overlay demotion removal

app-switcher-signals.description: Migrates KbqAppSwitcherTrigger consumers to its model()-based API (selectedApp reads become calls, writes become .set()) and warns on selectedSite value semantics, the removed header/footer/isTrapFocus/getIcon members and the new inline-icon sanitization

button-state-and-styles.description: Rewrites the removed physical border-radius mixins to logical ones and warns about the v20.3.0 button host-attribute, button-group ownership, .kbq-progress and locale changes

form-field-signals.description: Migrates KbqFormField and KbqHint consumers to the signal-based API (content-query and has* reads become calls, KbqPasswordHint.regex writes become .set()), moves [attr.aria-label] on kbq-cleaner to the [aria-label] input, and warns on the lost QueryList API, the removed mixinColor and the new required a11y locale keys

button-truncation.description: Moves edge icons of a button/button-toggle into the kbqButtonPrefix/kbqButtonSuffix slots so labels keep their ellipsis, and reports stylesheet overrides affected by the new truncation layout

tag-slots.description: Marks legacy implicit kbq-icon content in tags with kbqTagPrefix so tags can use explicit content slots

button-supported-colors.description: Removes button colors outside theme/theme-fade/contrast/contrast-fade from templates and warns about the ones it cannot resolve, plus the transparent default color change

mandatory-peer-dependencies.description: Adds @angular/animations, overlayscrollbars and @koobiq/date-adapter, which became mandatory peers of @koobiq/components, to projects whose package manager does not install new peers on upgrade

button-toggle-signals-and-aria.description: Migrates KbqButtonToggleGroup consumers to its signal inputs (vertical/multiple reads become calls) and reports the ARIA, tab-order and keyboard changes of the button-toggle review, including icon-only toggles left without an accessible name

scrollbar-deprecated-path.description: Rewrites @koobiq/components/scrollbar imports to @koobiq/components/scrollbar/deprecated — the overlayscrollbars-based implementation moved there when the dependency-free implementation was promoted to @koobiq/components/scrollbar

filter-bar-rename-action.description: Removes the `name` key from filter-bar locale configurations and reports the rename rework: renaming a filter no longer marks it saved, so it stops persisting the pending pipe edits

navbar-signals-and-aria.description: Migrates navbar consumers to the signal-based API (expanded/configuration/isCollapsed/collapsable reads become calls, expanded/tabIndex writes become .set(), rectangle-element horizontal/vertical become orientation) and reports the removed tooltip inheritance, the removed disabled/hovered members and the new ARIA, keyboard and z-index behaviour

locale-configuration-providers.description: Rewrites { provide: KBQ_<X>_CONFIGURATION, useValue: … } provider entries of the navbar, notification-center, app-switcher, search-expandable, datepicker and filter-bar to the kbq<X>LocaleConfigurationProvider() helpers, which is what still overrides the locale now that those tokens carry the defaults only, and warns on the provider shapes it cannot rewrite plus the removed externalConfiguration and read-only configuration members

list-tree-multiple-input.description: Rewrites the reworked multiple input of kbq-list-selection and kbq-tree-selection in ts and html
